<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="20" y="21" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="321" y1="15" x2="321" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="326" y1="12" x2="326" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="9" x2="331" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <rect x="361" y="13" width="15" height="5" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="380" y="13" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- top controls and progress -->

    <polyline points="29,57 21,65 29,73" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

    <text x="195" y="63" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">PROFILE SETUP</text>

  </g>

  <text x="22" y="132" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">What’s your body type?</text>
  <text x="22" y="157" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Choose the option that feels right for you</text>

  <!-- option card 1 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="22" y="181" width="165" height="142" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="22" y="181" width="165" height="142" rx="18" fill="none" stroke="url(#tinderGradient)" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <circle cx="168" cy="199" r="10" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <polyline points="163,199 167,203 174,195" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="104" cy="213" r="17" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <ellipse cx="104" cy="253" rx="24" ry="31" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <rect x="88" y="270" width="11" height="29" rx="5" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <rect x="109" y="270" width="11" height="29" rx="5" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="104" y="314" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">Slim</text>
  </g>

  <!-- option card 2 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="203" y="181" width="165" height="142" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="285" cy="213" r="17" fill="#D0CECD"/>

    <rect x="291" y="270" width="12" height="29" rx="5" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <text x="285" y="314" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Athletic</text>
  </g>

  <!-- option card 3 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="22" y="338" width="165" height="142" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="104" cy="370" r="17" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <ellipse cx="104" cy="410" rx="27" ry="31" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <rect x="87" y="427" width="12" height="29" rx="5" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <rect x="109" y="427" width="12" height="29" rx="5" fill="#D0CECD"/>

  <!-- option card 4 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="203" y="338" width="165" height="142" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="285" cy="370" r="17" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <ellipse cx="285" cy="410" rx="34" ry="31" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <rect x="267" y="427" width="12" height="29" rx="5" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <rect x="291" y="427" width="12" height="29" rx="5" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <text x="285" y="471" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Curvy</text>
  </g>

  <!-- option card 5 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="22" y="495" width="165" height="142" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="104" cy="527" r="17" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <ellipse cx="104" cy="567" rx="38" ry="31" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <rect x="87" y="584" width="12" height="29" rx="5" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <rect x="109" y="584" width="12" height="29" rx="5" fill="#D0CECD"/>

  </g>

  <!-- option card 6 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="203" y="495" width="165" height="142" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="285" cy="527" r="17" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <ellipse cx="285" cy="567" rx="32" ry="31" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <rect x="267" y="584" width="13" height="29" rx="5" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <rect x="290" y="584" width="13" height="29" rx="5" fill="#D0CECD"/>

  </g>

  <!-- option 7 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="651" width="346" height="40" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="671" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="59" y="676" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Prefer not to say</text>
    <text x="350" y="676" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Optional</text>
  </g>

  <!-- continue button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="57" y="710" width="276" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <text x="195" y="738" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="774" x2="390" y2="774" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="43,794 51,787 59,794 59,804 43,804" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polyline points="40,795 51,785 62,795" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="51" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="146" cy="796" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="153" y1="803" x2="160" y2="810" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="146" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">Discover</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <path d="M238 793 C234 788 226 791 226 797 C226 803 238 810 238 810 C238 810 250 803 250 797 C250 791 242 788 238 793Z" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="238" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">Matches</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="335" cy="794" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="335" cy="807" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="335" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FE3675">Profile</text>
  </g>

  <!-- home indicator -->
  <rect x="145" y="836" width="100" height="4" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
